0022600206.text: The Raptors (5-4, W1) host the Grizzlies (6-3, on a three-game losing streak) in a matchup of teams sitting 6th and 7th in their conferences, with Toronto 3 games back of the Atlantic lead and Memphis 1.5 games back in the Southwest. Toronto is missing Collin Murray-Boyles (illness), Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), while Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Raptors won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 128-96 regular-season win in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
